name: Wan quick preview

# Wan quick preview

> From the author's earlier studio, cleaned for publication: private paths, ports and some lines were removed, so a step may read short and a screen it names may not exist here. Status in this studio: Tested on the author's old stack.


## Purpose / when to use it
- A 3 s image-to-video sketch to check a motion idea before a full 81-frame render. Same model, same 4-step stack as
  `wan:i2v`; only the length changes (49 frames at 16 fps).

## Step-by-step in the studio UI
1. Video tab → "Wan 2.2 · Fast preview".
2. Drop the still in `image`; describe the motion.
3. Aspect: auto (follows the still) / 9:16 / 16:9. Generate.
4. Like it? Re-run the same prompt and still on "Wan 2.2 · Image → video" for the 81-frame clip (with LoRA presets).

## Optimal settings (pinned)
| Setting | Value | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Graph | `wan22_i2v_4s`: fp8 KJ experts, lightx2v v1030 high 1.0 + v1 low 1.0 baked, shift 5, 4 steps 2+2 euler/simple, CFG 1 | [tested] `b53_wan_orbit_none` |
| Length | 49 frames at 16 fps (3.1 s) | [tested] b53; [documented] pp `recipes/wan.json` `preview` |
| Size | 480x832 / 832x480 | [tested] |
| LoRA presets | none on the preview (presets were measured at 81 frames) | [inference] |

## Decode chip (standard / fast / preview)
`decode`: **standard** (default, the tested graph), **fast** = LightVAE Pro (1.45-1.5x decode, same quality as standard vs the source; finals), **preview** = LightVAE Lite (2.8-3x decode, 1-3.6 dB softer; drafts). Only the decode changes; the encode stays the stock Wan 2.1 VAE. On a 49-frame preview it saves about a second. Until  a local port has restarted with the LightVAE pack a fast/preview job renders standard with a card note. Numbers and details: [video-wan-decode.md](video-wan-decode.md).

## Prompting rules
- As Wan 2.2 image to video (`video-wan22-i2v-t2v.md`): describe the motion and the camera, not the still.

## Guards and gates
- Text guard, output guard on every frame (as every Wan job).

## Time and VRAM
- 13 s warm (b53), plus 130-190 s when the experts are cold. Port peak 64.9 GiB (the Wan budget, 64 GiB + floor).

## Known pitfalls
- Image to video only: no text-to-video row ran at 49 frames, so the tool refuses `t2v` with `preview`.
- The preview does not stay warm for the full render (the full render is a different entry); expect a reload only when
  something else used  a local port in between.

## Evidence
- `a local folder` row `b53_wan_orbit_none`: 13.0 s, 66486 MiB port.
- KB `the author's build notes "Fast preview" (CONFIRMED, never LTX); `audits/BEST_OPTIONS_2026-10-10/wan.md` "Fast preview".
